answer: New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 84 epochs rather than arriving at once. Farming becomes a comet bet on surviving 84 epochs of grading, and every walnut settlement recomputes the bridge schedule, so an adversary who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 18 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
